—Owari Kan-ryuu and its tube spears.

Granny Ichihime had told me about them once, while knitting. How knitting had led to spears, don't ask me.

Want to learn how frightening a spear is? Face Kan-ryuu. 'You only have to <ruby>dodge<rt>dodge</rt></ruby> the first thrust'—it would knock that <ruby>sleep-talk<rt>・・</rt></ruby> out of you in an instant. Something like that.

Haan, Granny. You were right. Dodge it. Absolutely. Now kindly explain how the hell I dodge THAT.

あれを躱す？

...What had Granny Ichihime said?

The guardedguarded school of the Owari Tokugawa. The Kan-ryuu spearpoint, kept hidden inside one domain for two hundred years because it was regarded as the supreme art of spearmanship. How do you seal that with a sword...

What was it again?

'Countermeasure? Hmm, let me think.'

'Can't dodge your way out of it. Block it and you only get knocked away.'

'Nothing. No way. Absolutely not.'

en.html:
Masamune growled in frustration.

The 'cannon' was a weapon that burst apart and scattered countless iron needles whether one dodged it or shot it down. It could not be defended against completely. The <ruby>arrowheads<rt>arrowheads</rt></ruby> sprayed across a wide area might fail to penetrate the enemy's thick torso plate, but they should have driven into the thin joints...

Yet when the spearpoint caught it and made it burst at long distance, how many needles had actually reached him? At worst, I had merely surprised him and caused almost no practical damage.

ja.html:
正宗が口惜しげに唸る。

〝鉄炮〟は避けようが撃ち落とそうが、爆裂四散して
無数の鉄針を飛ばす武器だ。防ぎ切ることはできない。
　広範囲に散る<ruby>鏃<rt>やじり</rt></ruby>は敵の分厚い胴体甲鉄は貫けずとも、
薄い関節部には突き刺さったはず……。

　しかしそれも、長槍の穂先に掛かって遠間で爆裂さ
せられたのでは、果たして何本が届いたか。
　下手をすると単に驚かせただけで、実質的な被害は
ほぼ皆無かもしれない。
